title: Drugs in rheumatology as a decision: steroids and NSAIDs relieve symptoms fast but do not stop joint damage; conventional DMARDs and then biologics modify the disease. Mnemonics: GLAM for high-dose prednisone, DORC for who should not get steroids, CUSHINGOID for chronic steroid side effects, GHMI for the shared DMARD toxicities
root: Treating inflammatory arthritis · relieve it now, modify it early

groups.title: Steroids: prednisone
groups.desc: Fast but non-specific. A short-term BRIDGE until a DMARD works.

lines.label: Emergency:
lines.text: IV methylprednisolone 1 g × 3 days first (GCA with vision loss)

drugs.name: Medium dose: flare, no organ threat

lines.text: Gout 25-30 mg × 3 days, taper 5 mg every 3 days
a few or weight-bearing joints · fewer systemic effects

lines.label: Never into:
lines.text: a SEPTIC joint · infected or psoriatic skin · prosthesis
+ proximal myopathy · acne · slow wound healing · gastritis · Cushing's appearance

groups.title: NSAIDs and analgesics
groups.desc: Relieve pain and swelling fast. NOT disease-modifying: no effect on erosions.

lines.text: OA · inflammatory arthritis · gout, pseudogout. If one fails, try another
LESS GI toxicity; heart and kidney risk the same
Analgesic, NOT anti-inflammatory: OA, mechanical pain
Hardly ever: they do not treat inflammation

groups.title: Conventional DMARDs
groups.desc: Prevent joint damage. EARLY (within 3 months), AGGRESSIVE (triple therapy), to TARGET (remission), adjust every 3-6 months.

note.label: Maternal Lung:
note.text: **M**ethotrexate and **L**eflunomide are teratogenic and cause pneumonitis

drugs.name: Methotrexate
drugs.agents: 20-25 mg WEEKLY + folic acid 5 mg weekly

lines.label: Also:
lines.text: acute PNEUMONITIS · mouth ulcers · fatigue · hair loss

lines.label: Retinal toxicity:
lines.text: bull's eye maculopathy, rare. Baseline + yearly EYE exam

lines.label: Also:
lines.text: ↓ visual acuity (accommodation) · GI upset · rash · sun sensitivity · headache

lines.label: Also:
lines.text: APLASTIC ANEMIA · headache · lightheadedness · rash, photosensitivity · reversible low sperm count

lines.label: Also:
lines.text: HYPERTENSION (BP at baseline) · peripheral neuropathy · pneumonitis · weight loss · hair loss

after.label: Not enough?
after.text: methotrexate by mouth → subcutaneous → add leflunomide → add a biologic

groups.title: Biologics
groups.desc: TARGETED and expensive (~$10-20,000 a year), so after other DMARDs fail.

lines.text: **T** TB, opportunistic infections · tumours: skin cancer (<1%), possibly lymphoma

lines.label: TNF in, TNF out. Avoid if already:
lines.text: active, recent or recurrent infection · active cancer · MS or a family history · HEART FAILURE III-IV
